description.narrative: PADEO is a new way of supporting sustainable international cooperation. The Dutch government introduced this approach in 2021 to improve collaboration between PSD programmes across various countries. By using PADEO, we bring together knowledge, resources and funding, in order to achieve a greater impact. For more information on this approach: https://english.rvo.nl/topics/padeoIn Tunisia, the system that has been chosen to work in is the agrifood sector. The main challenge to address is to stimulate jobs for youth (15-35 years old) in the agrifood sector (from farmer and producer organisations to the market).The inception phase of PADEO in Tunisia has been completed, and the EKN has entered the implementation phase. During this phase, we use a learning focused monitoring approach, which emphasizes learning from both results and from other stakeholders. The goal of reflexive monitoring is to continuously make adjustments based on lessons learned. The goal of this project is to facilitate this process with the help of a local consultancy firm. This process-focused approach helps us better understand the complexity of the change we envision, and take appropriate actions to reach it. By testing what works and what doesn't, we can continually improve our decisions, policies, and practices and achieve better results. External learning facilitators who can guide the reflexive monitoring process, will ensure that there is sufficient capacity to continuously learn throughout the process.
